guard: Every Pane-B audit disagreement must cite one or more exact policy.json JSON paths and the specific clause/criterion that decides the label. No disagreement may be resolved by intuition, averaging, or author preference.
adjudication: If neither label can cite a committed clause, mark the case UNASKABLE and add a policy amendment before relabeling; the conductor records the ruling and rationale.
reason: Prevents candidate-author ground truth from becoming negotiated and converts residual authorship risk into a text-checkable policy reference.
